typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Cntrol_File_Name as string (),
	Control_File_Namin_Convention as string (),
	Delimiter as string (),
	EmailMessageBody_Failure as string (),
	EmailMessageBody_Success as string (),
	EmailSubject_Failure as string (),
	EmailSubject_Success as string (),
	ExtractFolder_Path as string (),
	ExtractName as string (),
	FailureEmail as string (),
	File_Name as string (),
	File_Namin_Convention as string (),
	GRGR_CK as string (),
	MEMCNT as integer (),
	RecordCnt as integer (),
	ReportDate as string (),
	StoredProcExec as string (),
	StoredProcName as string (),
	StoredProcParameters as string (),
	SuccessEmailCC as string (),
	SuccessEmailTO as string ()
}

source(output(
		CF as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @Recordcount int Declare @MemberCount int  SET @Recordcount = ? SET @MemberCount = ?   SELECT	CF FROM	( 			Select CONCAT(\'Rows\',\'|\',\'Members\') AS CF, 1 AS RN 			UNION  			SELECT CONCAT(\'\',@Recordcount-1,\'\',\'|\',\'\',@MemberCount,\'\') AS CF, 2 AS RN 			 		)SRC ORDER BY RN',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = CF)) ~> FlatFileDestination
